content.text:
Perfect! The issue is fixed. The problem was floating-point precision errors when multiplying by 100 to convert euros to cents. Prices like 39.95 were becoming 3995.0000000000005 instead of 3995 due to how JavaScript handles decimal arithmetic. I've added `Math.round()` to all three conversion functions to ensure they always return clean integers.

Let me commit this fix:
